note: native application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: File/Edit/Selection/View/Go/Run/Terminal/Help
activity bar and accounts bar -- renders fixed operator icons: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings
status bar -- renders fixed operator status indicators: remote kind, problems count, forwarded ports, notifications, editor mode, EOL, encoding, indentation, selection, screen reader mode
aria container -- renders fixed operator accessibility alerts and status messages
editor tab bar controls -- renders fixed operator actions: close, split, more; subtracts the tab label which echoes the user's file name
